foundation: Simple Typed Higher-Order Logic with Hindley-Milner Polymorphism & Type Classes

mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: proof (induct n arbitrary: m rule: nat.induct)
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Higher-order resolution against the datatype induction theorem with universal quantification over arbitrary variables.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Structured Isar calculation with case (Suc n) keeping hypothesis names explicit.
dialect_pitfalls: Failure to declare arbitrary variables causing unprovable induction hypotheses
Rule selection ambiguity when inductive predicate shadows datatype
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: induction n with | zero => h0 | succ n' ih => hsucc

mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: by (simp add: eval)
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Code generator translation to Poly/ML or target language, compiled and executed out-of-band via oracle.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Define executable functions via fun and discharge finite instances via eval.
dialect_pitfalls: Reliance on code generation oracle introduces trust boundary beyond Pure logic kernel
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: by decide

mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: apply (simp add: my_lemma del: bad_lemma)
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Higher-order conditional term rewriting system with confluent ordered rewriting for AC-operators.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Use simp add: with controlled declarations; use subst with positional coordinates for exact non-confluent substitutions.
dialect_pitfalls: Simp loops caused by mutual equational cycles
Looped simplification of conditional rewrite rules whose premises diverge
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: simp only [add_comm, mul_zero]

mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: class group = monoid + inverse + assumes ...
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Order-sorted algebra with single-parameter axiomatic type classes and multi-parameter locales with interpretation morphisms.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Combine axiomatic type classes for arithmetic with locales for advanced abstract algebra (e.g. rings, modules).
dialect_pitfalls: Inability of Isabelle type classes to take multiple type parameters directly without locales
Hidden locale interpretation obligations
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: class Group (G : Type u) extends Monoid G, Inv G where ...

mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: by (metis add.commute mult.assoc) or by blast
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Generic tableaux reasoning (blast), ordered resolution provers (metis), and external ATP/SMT reconstruction (sledgehammer).
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Use sledgehammer interactively to discover minimal lemma sets, then reconstruct with deterministic metis.
dialect_pitfalls: Metis timeouts on complex higher-order goals
Sledgehammer finding proofs that fail local reconstruction
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: aesop (add safe ...) or omega

mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: have "a = b" proof ... also have "... <= c" proof ... finally show "a <= c" .
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Isar calculation rules registered via [trans] attribute, accumulating intermediate terms in the calculation register.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Chain also have statements culminating in finally show; use ellipsis ... for the antecedent term.
dialect_pitfalls: Order of terms reversed, breaking transitivity rule matching
Forgetting the final . or by assumption
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: calc a = b := h1 _ <= c := h2 _ < d := h3

mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: quotient_type 'a quottype = "'a rawtype" / "rel"
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Lifting and Transfer package automating the correspondence between raw representation types and quotiented abstract types.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Declare the quotient with quotient_type, define operations with quotient_definition, and transfer proofs with transfer.
dialect_pitfalls: Equivalence relation reflexivity/symmetry/transitivity proof obligations must be discharged before type definition
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: Quot.sound (h : a ~ b) or Quotient.lift f h_resp

mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: apply (cases t) or by simp (with datatype distinctness rules)
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Datatype distinctness (distinct) and injectivity (inject) theorems loaded automatically into the simplifier.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Invoke simp to automatically refute contradictory constructor equations like Suc n = 0.
dialect_pitfalls: Complex nested inductive predicates not recognized as datatypes requiring explicit elimination rules
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: injection h with h1 h2 or contradiction

mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: galois_connection l u
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Axiomatic type classes order, lattice, complete_lattice with Knaster-Tarski fixed-point operators lfp and gfp.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Use lfp_induct for structural fixpoint induction over inductive relations.
dialect_pitfalls: Monotonicity proof obligations must precede any fixpoint unfolding
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: GaloisConnection l u meaning l a <= b <-> a <= u b

mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: typedef 'a my_subtype = "{x::'a. P x}"
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Simple Type Theory type definition via non-empty predicate sets, creating bijective abstraction and representation morphisms.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Prove non-emptiness exists x. P x to create the type; manipulate elements via Rep_ and Abs_.
dialect_pitfalls: Subtypes in Isabelle are separate, distinct types; no implicit subtyping or subtyping coercions exist without explicit coercion functions
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: { x : A // P x } or <val, prop>

mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: SOME x. P x
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Higher-Order Logic is classical by default; Hilbert's epsilon operator Eps is built into the core logic.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Use SOME x. P x whenever an existential witness must be named; use by blast or by (rule ccontr) for classical refutation.
dialect_pitfalls: Functions defined via SOME cannot be executed by the code generator without explicit executable alternative equations
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: Classical.choose (h : exists x, P x) and Classical.choose_spec h

mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: inductive_set invariant where ... and lemma step_preserves: "s : invariant ==> step s : invariant"
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Inductive set definitions with automatic monotonic fixed-point calculations; probabilistic program verification packages.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Use induct on transition systems with auto-generated case rules.
dialect_pitfalls: Measure theory obligations when extending to continuous or uncountably infinite state spaces
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: theorem invariant_step (s : State) (h_inv : Inv s) : Inv (step s) and V (step s) <= alpha * V s

mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: by linarith | by presburger | by algebra | by sos
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Cooper's algorithm (`presburger`), Simplex/Fourier-Motzkin (`linarith`), Groebner bases (`algebra`), and sum-of-squares (`sos`).
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Map `by presburger` -> `by omega`, `by linarith` -> `by linarith`, and `by algebra` -> `by ring`.
dialect_pitfalls: `sos` relies on external CSDP certificates unless reconstructed; use `nlinarith` or `polyrith` in Lean 4
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: by omega | by linarith [h1, h2] | by ring | by positivity

mechanisms.canonical_name: Numeric Coercions, Cast Normalization & Denominator Clearing
mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: by (simp add: field_simps of_nat_add)
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Simp-set collections (`field_simps`, `divide_simps`) that cross-multiply denominators under `if d = 0` splits, plus `of_nat_*` homomorphisms.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Translate `simp add: field_simps` to `field_simp; ring` and `of_nat_*` simp chains to `norm_cast` / `push_cast`.
dialect_pitfalls: Isabelle's `field_simps` splits on `d = 0 \/ d != 0` automatically, whereas Lean's `field_simp` looks for `d != 0` in context
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: push_cast; ring | zify [h_le] at *; omega | field_simp [hne]; ring

mechanisms.canonical_name: Well-Founded Recursion, Termination Measures & Functional Induction
mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: function f where ... by pat_completeness auto termination by (relation "measure g") auto | proof (induct rule: f.induct)
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Krauss's `function` package generating `.simps` and custom computation induction `f.induct`.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Map `termination by (relation "measure g")` to `termination_by g x` and `induct rule: f.induct` to `fun_induction f`.
dialect_pitfalls: Isabelle `<*mlex*>` lexicographic measures map to tuple measures `(m1 x, m2 x)` in Lean 4 `termination_by`
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: def f (x : alpha) : beta := ... termination_by measure x decreasing_by omega | fun_induction f x with ...

mechanisms.canonical_name: Measure Spaces, Lebesgue/Bochner Integration & Almost-Everywhere Filters
mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: LINT x:M. f x | integral⇧N M f | AE x in M. P x
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Hölzl-Himmelmann `HOL-Analysis` / `HOL-Probability` non-negative integral (`integral⇧N` on `ennreal`) and Bochner integral (`LINT`).
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Mathlib's `MeasureTheory` is a direct descendant of Isabelle's `HOL-Analysis`: `integral⇧N M f` -> `∫⁻ x, f x ∂μ`, `LINT x:M. f x` -> `∫ x, f x ∂μ`, `AE x in M` -> `∀ᵐ x ∂μ`.
dialect_pitfalls: Isabelle measures carry an explicit carrier set `space M` (`x ∈ space M`), whereas Mathlib uses the full type `α` with `[MeasurableSpace α]`
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: ∫ x in s, f x ∂μ | ∫⁻ x, g x ∂μ | ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, P x | filter_upwards [h1, h2] with x hx1 hx2

mechanisms.canonical_name: Big Operators, Finite Sums/Products & Indexed Monoid Folding
mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: (∑x∈A. f x) | (∏x∈A. f x)
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: `Groups_Big.sum` over `'a set` (returning `0` automatically when `infinite A`).
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Translate `(∑x∈A. f x)` under `finite A` to `∑ x ∈ A, f x` over `A : Finset α`.
dialect_pitfalls: Isabelle `∑x∈A. f x` defaults to `0` on infinite sets; if finiteness is not obvious in Lean 4, use `finsum` (`∑ᶠ x, f x`) or carry `A : Finset α`
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: ∑ x ∈ s, f x | ∏ x ∈ s, f x | ∑ x ∈ s with P x, f x

mechanisms.canonical_name: Bitvectors, Machine Words, SWAR & Bit-Blasting Decision Procedures
mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: x :: 64 word | by word_bitwise | by unat_arith
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: `HOL-Library.Word` (`'a::len word` inside seL4 / l4v) with `word_bitwise` and `unat_arith`.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Map `by word_bitwise` -> `by bv_decide`, `by unat_arith` -> `by bv_omega`, and `bit_eqI` -> `BitVec.ext`.
dialect_pitfalls: Isabelle `'a::len word` enforces `0 < LENGTH('a)` via the `len` sort, whereas Lean `BitVec 0` is valid
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: by bv_decide | by bv_omega | ext i hi; simp [BitVec.getLsbD]

mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: by (rule ext) | by (auto intro!: set_eqI) | arg_cong
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: HOL primitive axiom `ext : (\<And>x. f x = g x) \<Longrightarrow> f = g` and set extensionality `set_eqI`.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Map `rule ext`, `set_eqI`, and record `.equality` rules to a single `ext` call in Lean 4.
dialect_pitfalls: Isabelle `cong` inside `simp` requires explicit `[cong]` registration
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: ext x y | funext x | congr 1

mechanisms.canonical_name: Filters, Nets, Eventualities & Topological Limit Convergence
mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: (f ⤏ l) (at x within s) | (u ⇢ l) | ∀⇩F n in sequentially. P n
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Hölzl-Immler-Huffman filter hierarchy (`(f ⤏ l) F`, `nhds x`, `at x within s`, `sequentially` / `at_top`).
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Translate `(u ⇢ l)` -> `Tendsto u atTop (𝓝 l)`, `(f ⤏ l) (nhds x)` -> `Tendsto f (𝓝 x) (𝓝 l)`, and `eventually_mono` -> `filter_upwards`.
dialect_pitfalls: CRITICAL SEMANTIC DELTA: Isabelle's `at x within s` is the *punctured* filter `𝓝[s \ {x}] x` (and `at x` is `𝓝[≠] x`), whereas Mathlib's `𝓝[s] x` (`nhdsWithin x s`) *includes* `x`!
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: Tendsto f (𝓝 x) (𝓝 y) | Tendsto u atTop (𝓝 l) | ∀ᶠ n in atTop, P n
